statement: The sharing record gives a status of approved external sharing with parental consent on file, but the file must be placed on hold because no parent has consented to sharing children's home addresses outside the district.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the record's "approved... parental consent on file" contradicts the fact that "no parent has consented," so the share must be held.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
